name: Web Radio
summary: Listen to internet radio stations from around the world on {player}.
description: Plays internet radio from radio-browser.info, a free, community-maintained directory of more than 50,000 stations: the most played, top voted and high quality stations, and stations by genre, country and language, all searchable. No account is needed. Not made or endorsed by radio-browser.info.

notes: Requires Kalinka Player server 5.20.0 or newer (below 6.0.0), which brings plugin SDK 3.23, and Python 3.11 or newer.
No account is needed. The server reaches the radio-browser.info directory over HTTPS, and the renderer plays each station's stream from the station's own server.
Only stations the renderer can decode are listed: MP3, AAC and FLAC streams. Stations streaming over HLS, or in Opus or Ogg, are left out.
Choosing a station plays that station alone with the Kalinka Player app 0.28.0 or newer; an older app also queues the stations after it.

The package is architecture-independent but requires a compatible Debian-packaged Kalinka Player server and resolvable Python dependencies. It is built and tested on Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04, on amd64 and arm64. It is not a macOS, Windows or RPM package.
